findings.title: Partial Main/API cutover cannot safely resume
findings.trigger: Coordinator stops during Main processing before creating the API checkpoint; both next-spawn guards have already been armed.
findings.error: On --resume, a missing API checkpoint always raises MISSING_RESUME_CHECKPOINT. A completed Main checkpoint also returns DONE without checking its replacement process or after-state.
findings.impact: The same owned operation cannot finish API continuation, leaving its root-armed next-spawn state outstanding. Completed Main drift is not detected before continuation.
independent_evidence: Owned-temp fake CLI reproduced Main DONE plus missing API checkpoint => MISSING_RESUME_CHECKPOINT.
Owned-temp Recipe probe established that DONE returns True without calling replacement readback.
Refreshed handoff currently accepts only historical original PIDs; it lacks explicit completed-role current identity bindings.
findings.bounded_repair: Represent completed and untouched roles explicitly. Safely initialize both checkpoints or admit a missing untouched role only after verifying original identity, root acknowledgement and absence of prior intent. Revalidate completed role after-plist bytes/metadata, loaded binding, cwd and checkpointed replacement PID/start/command. Never rearm root or signal a completed role.
findings.required_regression: Interrupt during Main before API checkpoint creation, refresh the same-operation handoff, resume both roles successfully; reject completed-owner drift and ambiguous untouched-role state; assert no repeated TERM/root action.
